description: An opaque blue floor-length gown has a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves, and restrained geometric woven borders around the neckline, sleeve cuffs, central panels, and hem. Cream underdress fabric shows at the neckline and central skirt opening. A brown patterned sash with tassel ends and a round shoulder brooch accompany a grey-brown fringed wool wrap around the forearms. Brown shoes appear beneath the hem.
